contributions.detail: THE SIDE IS 'none' AND THE STATED TOTAL IS ZERO - so this is honest non-existence with NOTHING MISSING, not a gap. Both pages of the PDF were rendered and read: p1 is the cover and p2 the Summary Page, and there is no Schedule A page in the document. The brief's test was whether the Summary Page states a NON-ZERO total against a missing schedule; it does not. Summary line 1 Column A prints the glyph '-0-' and line 4 ('From Line 1 Column A') prints '-0-' as well. Per the repo-wide zero-glyph ruling a '-0-' DENOTES zero, so the filer states zero contributions this period and there is nothing a Schedule A could have itemized. No sum is claimed for the side because no schedule exists to sum.
